behavior: Job page and quote page follow the change rules: one shared accept form, a withdrawn change's notice stays, no change on a finished job, the final waits for a change, and the toast says where the link went
acceptance: The quote's accept and a change's accept use one ConsentForm (name, email, checks, field errors, messages); the old duplicate code is gone.

When the client's accept of a change answers 404, the quote page says the change was withdrawn or replaced above the payments, focus moves there, and the notice stays after the re-read removes the form.

On a finished job (the last agreed payment done) Propose a change is gone; a deposit-only job still has it. While a change waits, the final payment shows that its invoice waits for the change instead of Mark done.

Propose's toast names the address when clientEmailed, else says to send the link; the dialog says the client gets an email; 409 change_pending and job_finished each get their own message, also in Mark done; a waiting change says where its link was sent.
Due days read 'due 1 day after' for one day on the job page, the quote page and Mark done; DESIGN.md, R-106, api.md and openapi.yaml describe the changes.
